description: Asrai's crypto calendar: what's coming in the next N days (default 7) — US market days (Fed rate decision, CPI inflation, jobs report, BTC/ETH options expiry) with what usually happens to BTC, exchange notices (Binance / Upbit / Coinbase delistings, warning tags, new listings, token swaps, deposit pauses for network upgrades), big token unlocks and project events. Use for: 'what's coming this week', 'any CPI or Fed this week', 'is SOL being delisted', 'events for my coins'. Free.

coins.description: Only events for these coins (plus market days), comma-separated tickers, e.g. 'SOL,ARB'

type.description: Only one kind of event (default all)
